# LeAna Powell for Oakland School Board, District 6

> Official campaign website of LeAna Powell, an Oakland native, mother of three, and parent advocate running for Oakland School Board, District 6 (Oakland Unified School District, California). The site is available in English and Spanish (add ?lang=es). Campaign slogan: "Rooted in Oakland. Fighting for kids." Hashtag: #MamaBearForOUSD.

## Key facts
- Candidate: LeAna Powell. Her family has been in Oakland public schools for five generations; she has two children in OUSD and one who graduated.
- Role: active in the Burckhalter Elementary PTO; experience in budget and policy advocacy at the California State Capitol and with education nonprofits.
- Office sought: Oakland School Board, District 6.
- Contact: leana@leanaforoaklandschools.com

## Pages
- [Home and About](https://leanaforoaklandschools.com/): who LeAna is and why she is running
- [Priorities](https://leanaforoaklandschools.com/issues): budget stability, reading and math, family and community engagement
- [Endorsements](https://leanaforoaklandschools.com/endorsements): elected officials, educators, parents and community leaders
- [Events](https://leanaforoaklandschools.com/events): upcoming and past campaign events
- [Volunteer](https://leanaforoaklandschools.com/volunteer): ways to help
- [Articles & Achievements](https://leanaforoaklandschools.com/achievements): press, letters of support, resources
- [Get Updates](https://leanaforoaklandschools.com/text-updates): email and text sign-up
